title: Launchpad visuals: quickstart screenshots, pricing overlays, and deprecation states
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Produce a set of onboarding and release screenshots for the Model Catalog page that cover (1) first-time onboarding/quickstart flow, (2) new model launch tiles with pricing overlays, and (3) deprecation states for retiring models. Deliverables:
- 6 hero screenshots sized for release notes and help center (1200x630 + 1440x900 variants) showing catalog landing, selected model details, and quickstart CTA flows.
- 3 pricing overlay comps (per-token vs. bundled plans) with hover and collapsed states.
- 4 deprecation state assets: banner, retired model card, migration CTA, and changelog link.
- Microcopy callouts for quickstart steps and migration guidance.
Acceptance criteria:
- Screenshots match Console styling tokens and responsive constraints.
- Pricing overlays reflect PM-provided rates (see links).
- All assets exported as PNG + SVG + source Figma file with componentized variants.
- Hand-off notes and style-token mapping included in the attached Confluence doc.
comments: 2025-02-20 - Kickoff: scoped deliverables with PM. PM provided pricing tiers and migration messaging. (PM: L. Chen)

2025-02-24 - Initial sketches uploaded to Figma: two layout directions (compact list vs. hero tiles). Preference from PM is hero tiles for marketing release; console team prefers compact. Need to reconcile for release notes.

2025-02-26 - Design decision: use hero tiles on marketing/release notes and provide compact console screenshots for docs to avoid conflicting with Console UI team. Logged trade-off in comments and linked Console thread.

2025-02-28 - Engineering feedback: images must not exceed 600KB for CDN; suggested using optimized SVG for overlays and PNG for hero images. Also flagged tokenized pricing values must come from API snapshot.
2025-03-01 - PM review: requested alternative color for deprecation banner (avoid red; prefer amber + neutral CTA). Updated comps and uploaded V2.
2025-03-02 - Design review: UX lead approved layout and copy. Requested one additional screenshot showing the quickstart modal with 'pin model' option. Added to scope (estimate +1).
2025-03-03 - Ready for developer hand-off: exported assets in drive, added hand-off checklist. Waiting on final sign-off from Console engineering for image size and alt-texts.
